premises.scope: For every probability law mu, sup_{epsilon>0,y}(mu*gamma_epsilon)(y)=||p_mu||_infinity, with +infinity if no bounded density exists.
For exact rank-three signature (+,+,-), the positive one-sheet output submeasure is dominated by C_lambda dx with C_lambda<=pi sqrt(2)/s.
At every global Laplace mode of an atomless law, the right and left exponentially weighted masses balance exactly.

new_results.statement: If an output submeasure mu_G is dominated by B dx, then at every scaled Laplace global mode of height L, each balanced half-posterior gives G mass at most B/L and G^c mass at least 1-B/L.

For every r>0, the unpaid event G^c has probability at least [epsilon(L-B)-e^{-r}]_+ in each adjacent interval of length r epsilon around the Laplace mode. Choosing r=log(2/[epsilon(L-B)]) gives epsilon(L-B)/2 on each side.

For events G_j with mu_{G_j}<=C_j dx, harmonic weights h_j=1/C_j and H=sum h_j give E_{nu_+}W,E_{nu_-}W<=N/(HL). Any lower coverage delta on either balanced half implies L<=N/(H delta); if H/N>=c s3(A), then s3(A)L<=1/(c delta).

Applying account04/B15 one-sheet domination, every exact-rank-three (+,+,-) Laplace global mode with y_*>=0, including y_*=0, has height at most C_lambda<=pi sqrt(2)/s. Any larger mode is strictly minority-side and exhibits two-sided two-sheet packing.

At a positive Gaussian heat mode with a=y_*/epsilon, partner one-sheet cap B gives M<=B exp(v^2/2)/(1-exp(-av)) for every v>0; for 0<a<=1, M<3.298 B/a, improving the previous quadratic near-vertex loss.
